dedupe_keys.name: a georeferenced dataset for mapping and assessing subgrade defects in china s high speed railways

description: A Georeferenced Dataset for Mapping and Assessing Subgrade Defects in China’s High-Speed Railways is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Wang, Jinchen et al. China has the world’s longest high-speed rail (HSR) network, marked by dense transportation and complex operations. However, frequent train use coupled with extreme weather conditions has led to rising subgrade issues. Existing railway defect records suffer from inconsistency, hindering direct applicability. Currently, there is a lack of a relevant dataset dedicated to HSR subgrade defects. Coverage: global (CN); published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 198186 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
